command: import os,pathlib,json,threading; p=pathlib.Path("synthetic-rehearsal.bin"); data=b"r"*32768; f=p.open("wb"); f.write(data); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno()); f.close(); assert p.read_bytes()==data; print(json.dumps({"synthetic_only":True,"proc_io":pathlib.Path("/proc/self/io").read_text(),"cgroup":pathlib.Path("/proc/self/cgroup").read_text()}),flush=True); threading.Event().wait(1); p.unlink()
